name: Impala
description:
Smarter data, greater impact, right inside your AI workflow. Impala's connector gives you instant organization and funder intel on any U.S. nonprofit or foundation, drawn live from a database of 2M+ nonprofits, 250K+ grantmakers, and 25M+ grants built from verified registries, government databases, and direct partnerships.

Built for the teams that power philanthropy: grants management, programs, development, funder networks, and advisors. 

Ask it to:
- Research any nonprofit or foundation: mission, programs, leadership, board, and how to apply
- Check financial health with Form 990 income statements, balance sheets, key ratios, and multi-year trends
- Verify an organization's 501(c)(3) tax-exempt standing
- Map who funds whom: a nonprofit's institutional funders, a foundation's grantees, and grant histories
- Understand a funder's giving profile by cause area and geography, or spot funder overlap across organizations
- Discover new nonprofits and funders by cause, geography, type, and size

Every answer is source-attributed and links back to the full record on Impala so you can verify the underlying data. All tools are read-only. Connecting creates a free Impala account; some tools may require a premium Impala subscription.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Impala to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Impala to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.impala.digital/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Impala MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Impala lists 16 MCP tools, including get_990_financials, get_board_and_team, get_current_user, get_funder_overlap, get_funders, get_funders_for_peers, get_giving_profile, get_grantees, get_grants_given, get_grants_received, get_organization_profile, and search_attributes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Impala?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Impala in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Impala requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Impala is developed by Impala. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
